title: Deep learning from the crowd Fundamentals of morphological galaxy classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.06316v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aims. The objective of this work is to adapt a deep neural network model to perform galaxy morphological classification trained from crowd annotations, considering the training scheme, the agreement between the annotators, and the hierarchy.   Methods. We use Galaxy Zoo 1 as our experimental testbed and trained a convolutional neural network (CNN) for the automatic classification of galaxies' morphologies. We analyze the impact of the following aspects on the classification accuracy and training efficiency: (i) Training only the last layer vs. training all the network; (ii) Classification with only the CNN vs. considering the hierarchy; (iii) Comparing the models trained with different amounts of data and levels of agreement between the annotators; (iv) Training by stages, transferring knowledge from one model to another; and (v) Combining several models as an ensemble. translated_title: 从群众中深度学习：星系形态分类的基础
translated_abstract: 目的：本工作的目标是调整深度神经网络模型，使其能够基于群众标注进行训练并完成星系形态分类，同时考虑训练方案、标注者之间的一致性以及分类层级结构。方法：我们以Galaxy Zoo 1作为实验测试平台，训练卷积神经网络（CNN）对星系形态进行自动分类。我们分析了以下几个方面对分类准确率和训练效率的影响：(i) 仅训练最后一层与训练整个网络的对比；(ii) 仅使用CNN分类与考虑层级结构的对比；(iii) 比较使用不同数据量和不同标注者一致性水平训练的模型；(iv) 分阶段训练，将知识从一个模型迁移到另一个模型；(v) 将多个模型组合为集成模型。结果：从实验中我们得出以下结果：（注：原文摘要在此处截断，结果部分内容不完整）
tldr: 该研究以Galaxy Zoo 1为实验平台，系统探索了基于群众标注训练卷积神经网络进行星系形态分类的多种策略（如层级结构、分阶段迁移训练与模型集成），为众包数据驱动的深度学习天文分类奠定了方法基础。
en_tdlr: This study systematically investigates multiple strategies for training convolutional neural networks from crowd annotations for galaxy morphological classification using Galaxy Zoo 1, establishing methodological fundamentals for deep learning from crowdsourced astronomical data.
